instruction: Turn off the VLC player's background cone image so it doesn't appear when watching videos.

command: import pyautogui; import time; pyautogui.click({SCREEN_WIDTH_HALF}, {SCREEN_HEIGHT_HALF}); time.sleep(0.5);

metadata.explanation: Task requires disabling the background cone in VLC (qt-bgcone=0). This is a similar configuration change to the original color task. Uses existing check_qt_bgcone metric function which validates the qt-bgcone setting in vlcrc config file is set to 0 (disabled). Similar complexity and interaction pattern to original task.
metadata.verification: Verified by examining check_qt_bgcone function in vlc.py:335-362. The function reads vlcrc, extracts qt-bgcone value (default '1'), and compares against expected value '0'.
